notes.title: no more stuff...
notes.content:
hi, we know its been a while. as of 1/20/23, we are putting no more updates to slothgate part 1. we have a couple reasons for this:

1. We Are More Focused On Slothgate: Death's Door
2. The Project Files Broke

About The Future Of Slothgate:
we will add more weapons, story, a few modes for Post-Campaign content, and better graphics. we will have a page sometime by the end of February.

sorry for a more lengthy post, we hope to see you soon.

~Great Studios Gaming Team
